source.title: University of California at San Diego: Social Sciences Building and Super Computer Office Building

limitations: Ground and second level diagrams have no room identifiers or room areas. They cannot establish a reliable join to the missing schedule rooms.
The page contains two different building components; adjacent Super Computer Office addition geometry must not be assigned to SSB.
Project completion in 1995 does not establish current interior partition configuration.
No third-level plan is provided. The second-level plan must not be relabeled as the missing third level.
nextEvidenceNeeded: Numbered ground/third-floor plan, or independent authoritative room-number map sufficient to identify and validate individual boundaries.
